 Let's start the night off by taking a look back over the three biggest stories of Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026.
 UFC pushing for Josh Hokit vs. Ciryl Gane 2, but 'ethical issue' may prevent immediate rematch : Give the immediate rematches a rest! Hokit has plenty of time to earn another title shot if he's worthy.
 Conor McGregor celebrates GTA 6 launch by giving all 400 of his employees the day off : For those who picked up the new Grand Theft Auto , how are you liking it?
 UFC Qatar's Brian Ortega gets questioned about his Tracy Cortez lip tattoo: 'It fades away with time' : Who says you can't learn new life lessons in your 30s?
